from z3 import *

# Parameters
num_golfers = 30
num_weeks = 7
num_groups = 10

# Variables: group[w][p] in 0..9
grp = [[Int(f'g_{w}_{p}') for p in range(num_golfers)] for w in range(num_weeks)]

s = Solver()

# Domain constraints
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for p in range(num_golfers):
        s.add(grp[w][p] >= 0, grp[w][p] < num_groups)

# Each week, each group has exactly 3 golfers
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for g in range(num_groups):
        # sum of booleans group == g equals 3
        s.add(Sum([If(grp[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(num_golfers)]) == 3)

# No pair meets more than once
for i in range(num_golfers):
    for j in range(i+1, num_golfers):
        s.add(Sum([If(grp[w][i] == grp[w][j], 1, 0) for w in range(num_weeks)]) <= 1)

print("Constraints added, solving...")
res = s.check()
print(res)
